Complete [[Augury Rock]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Defeat your [[Doppelganger]] at Augury Rock.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 10 minutes (2 minutes in [[Hard Mode]]).
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Augury Rock#Walkthrough|Augury Rock]] mission.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Mission]]
: ''"Are you ready for [[ascension]]? Ready to see if you are your own worst enemy? At Augury Rock, you face the final trial: your own doppelganger."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
{{bug|The mission doesn't need to be a success. Defeating the Doppelganger is enough to complete the quest; however, the first bonus is not satisfied if you die before the Doppelganger.}}
